nodes.question: Has the image background been changed to depict a basketball-court setting?
nodes.criteria: complete: the background has been replaced with a recognizable basketball-court setting, supported by court cues such as a hoop, basketball, or court-floor markings; the entire court need not be visible. partial: some basketball- or court-related cues appear in the background, but they do not establish a basketball-court setting, or the background change is only partial. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background to a basketball court. unknown: image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the background depicts a basketball-court setting.
nodes.binding: Assess the image background, not the foreground subject. Determine from visible image evidence whether the background depicts a basketball-court setting; the whole court need not be visible.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
